ingredients.water: Water: half a cup (total in the list); for grinding, the method says "a little water"
ingredients.water-add: Water (for the curd mixture): as needed
ingredients.oil: Oil: mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.mustard: Mustard seeds: mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.curry-leaf: Curry leaves: mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.asafoetida: Asafoetida: mentioned in the method; no quantity given

actions.ground: Put the dill leaves, grated coconut, green chilli, ginger, cumin, salt and a little water in a mixie and grind smooth.
actions.mixed: Transfer this mixture to a bowl and add the curd and as much water as needed.
actions.tempering: For the tempering, heat oil in a small pot, add mustard seeds, curry leaves and asafoetida, and make the tempering.

ingredients.dill: Finely chopped dill leaves: half a cup
ingredients.water: Water: mentioned in the method (add a little at a time); no quantity given
ingredients.leaf: Banana leaf or plastic cover: mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.oil-greasing: Oil (to grease the leaf/cover): mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.oil-top: Oil (to pour over the tava): a little

actions.bowl-mix: Put the rice flour, salt, chopped dill leaves, onion, green chilli and coriander leaves into a bowl.
actions.dough: Add water a little at a time and knead the dough soft.
actions.pressed: Grease a banana leaf or plastic cover with oil, make a ball of the dough, press it thin by hand and put it on the tava.
actions.cooked: Pour a little oil over the top and cook on both sides.

ingredients.chana-dal: Chana dal soaked for three hours: one cup
ingredients.dill: Finely chopped dill leaves: three-quarters of a cup

actions.ground: Put the soaked chana dal in a mixie. Grind coarsely with the green chilli and ginger, without adding water.
actions.mixed: Add the chopped onion, dill leaves and salt to this mixture and mix well by hand.
actions.steamed: Shape into balls and steam for 15 minutes, and the dill kadubu is ready. Enjoy with coconut chutney and tomato chutney.

ingredients.salt: Salt: to taste (total in the list); for cooking the dal, the method says "a little salt"
ingredients.water: Water: two cups (mentioned in the method)
ingredients.fat: Oil or ghee (for the tempering): no quantity given

actions.boiled-dal: Add two cups of water, turmeric and a little salt to the toor dal and cook.
actions.with-veg: Add the chopped dill leaves, onion, tomato, green chilli and garlic to this and simmer on low heat for five more minutes.
actions.with-tamarind: Once the dal is well softened, add the tamarind juice.
actions.tempering: Then make a tempering in a pot, and
actions.serve: add it to the cooked dal mixture. Enjoy with hot rice, adding ghee.

ingredients.ghee-sheets: Ghee: one bowl (total in the list)
ingredients.water-dough: Water: one bowl (total in the list)
ingredients.water-syrup: Water (for the sugar syrup): mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.water-seal: Water (to stick the end): mentioned in the method; no quantity given

actions.dough: Add the maida, two spoons of ghee and salt, mix well, add water, knead into a stiff dough and leave to rest for ten minutes.
actions.syrup: Add water to the sugar, boil and take it off the heat.
actions.lemon-syrup: Add the lemon juice and keep aside.
actions.rolled: Divide the dough into five balls and roll out thin.
actions.brushed: Melt the ghee, brush it thinly over one sheet, and sprinkle cornflour thinly on top.
actions.roll-up: Stack all five sheets one on top of another, roll up lightly into a spiral, and stick the end by smearing it with water.
actions.cut: Cut with a knife into one-centimetre pieces.
actions.fried: Fry in hot oil until golden.
actions.dipped: Once cooled, dip in the sugar syrup and take out.

ingredients.jaggery: Powdered jaggery: three-quarters of a bowl
ingredients.dates: Finely chopped dates: three-quarters of a bowl
ingredients.seeds-nuts: Pumpkin seeds, watermelon seeds, muskmelon seeds, almonds, cashews, pistachios: one bowl
ingredients.water-seal: Water (to stick): mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.oil: Oil for frying: no quantity given

actions.dough: Combine the maida, rava, ghee and salt, add milk, knead into a soft dough and set aside.
actions.crushed: Except the raisins and dates, warm the remaining dry fruits a little and, once cooled, crush coarsely.
actions.filling: Add the dry coconut, powdered jaggery, dates, raisins and cardamom powder to this to prepare the filling.
actions.rolled: Knead the maida dough well, make small balls and roll out thin.
actions.filled: Place this in the karjikayi mould, add two spoons of filling, and stick the edges by smearing water all around.
actions.fried: Now remove from the mould and fry in hot oil until golden.

ingredients.water: Water (for grinding): mentioned in the method; no quantity given
ingredients.ghee-tray: Ghee: two spoons (total in the list); for greasing the plate, mentioned in the method

actions.juice: Grind the grated beetroot and grated coconut with water and make four bowls of juice.
actions.boiling: Add sugar to three bowls of the juice, put it in a pan and place it on the stove to boil.
actions.slurry: Add the cornflour to one bowl of the juice, mix without lumps and keep aside.
actions.thickened: Once it comes to a good boil, add the juice mixed with cornflour and keep stirring so that it does not stick to the bottom.
actions.with-ghee: When it turns thick in ten minutes and starts leaving the bottom, add one spoon of ghee and mix well.
actions.set: Pour onto a plate greased with ghee and cut once cooled.

ingredients.water: Water: two bowls (total in the list)
ingredients.water-knead: Water (to knead the dough): a little
ingredients.chilli-powder: Chilli powder: mentioned in the method; no quantity given

actions.boiling-water: Put water in a pan and set it to boil.
actions.cooked-rava: Then add the rava, cook without lumps, add the ghee and leave to cool.
actions.dry-mix: In a vessel, put the rice flour, chilli powder, cumin, sesame seeds and salt and mix well.
actions.dough: Add the cooked rava to this, add a little water and knead to the consistency of chapati dough.
actions.fried: Put it in the chakkuli press, press out the chakkuli and fry in hot oil.

ingredients.tray-ghee: Ghee to grease the plate: mentioned in the method; no separate quantity given

actions.roasted: Roast on low heat until fragrant.
actions.mixture: Mix well so that no lumps form.
actions.ground-nuts: Coarsely crush the cashews and almonds.
actions.thickened: Add the powder; cook on medium heat, stirring continuously, until the mixture leaves the bottom of the pan.
actions.tray: Grease the plate with ghee beforehand.
actions.cut: Pour onto the plate and, once slightly cooled, cut into the desired shape.
actions.serve: Once fully cooled, separate the pieces.

ingredients.water: Water for soaking: mentioned in the method; no quantity given

actions.soaked: Soak for 4–5 hours and drain the water completely.
actions.mashed: Boil and mash; the source article gives no time.
actions.ground: Roast and powder; the source article gives no time.
actions.mixture: Mix well in a large vessel.
actions.shaped: Take a little portion and pat it into a flat vada shape.
actions.fried: Fry on medium heat on both sides until golden and crisp.
actions.serve: Enjoy with chutney or curd (optional accompaniments).
